 HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN  BENCH AT JAIPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 584/2024 Nitesh Kumar S/o Shri Kamal Singh, Aged About 27 Years, R/o Kanchanpura, P.s. Kherli, District Alwar.

sentences.text:
(At Present Confined In Central Jail Alwar)
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp
----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Mohar Pal Meena through VC.

For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mangal Singh Saini,
PP through VC.
HON'BLE
MR. JUSTICE BIRENDRA KUMAR Order 15/02/2024 1.
Heard the parties.

2. This Criminal Misc. Bail Application has been brought under Section 439 of Cr.P.C., in connection with FIR No.228/2023 registered with Police Station - Kherli, District Alwar for offences under Sections 366, 376(2)(n) and 506 of IPC.
3.
The victim of crime is a mother of two children.
Allegation is that the petitioner induced her and provided her with a mobile phone, thereafter, both were talking and the petitioner was pressurizing her for marriage.
Further allegation is of commission of sexual assault.
The FIR as well as statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. reveals that it was a case of consensual relationship and after break-up of relationship, the FIR was lodged.

The victim was mature enough to know the [2024:RJ-JP:7948] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-584/2024] consequences of her act and accepting allurement of the petitioner of marriage, though she was already married and had not got any divorce from her husband appears unbelievable and unacceptable.
4. Learned Public Prosecutor opposed the prayer for bail.

5. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case above, let the above named Nitesh Kumar S/O Shri Kamal Singh vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jp:7948) on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82545677/
1 accused-petitioner be released on bail in the aforesaid FIR, if he is not wanted in any other case,
provided that he furnishes a bail bond of Rs.25,000/- with two sureties of like amount to the satisfaction of the learned trial court with following conditions:-
(i) the petitioner shall fully co-operate in the investigation/trial, failing which, the trial judge would be at liberty to cancel the bail bonds of the petitioner.

(iii) the petitioner shall not tamper with the evidence.
6. Accordingly, the instant bail application stands allowed.
